results.name: Shamy, Shipers & Lonski, P.C.

wrong_claims.claim: Contact form is buried on the location page rather than the Contact link target
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The main nav 'CONTACT' item links to /east-brunswick-location#CONTACT and an element with id CONTACT exists there holding the form, so the Contact link does land on the form. What is true is that the only form sitewide sits on the East Brunswick location page and there is no separate contact page (/contact returns HTTP 404).

wrong_claims.claim: Hours are 8:30-5 weekdays with weekends 'by appointment' (cited to /contact)
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The hours block on the East Brunswick location page reads only 'Monday through Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.'; no weekend-by-appointment wording appears anywhere on the site, and the cited URL /contact returns HTTP 404.

wrong_claims.claim: At a 390px viewport the document is 768px wide
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The home page scroll width is 842px at a 390px viewport; 768px is the scroll width of /east-brunswick-location. The mobile overflow itself is real on both pages and the nav is clipped.

results.notes: Operating; general-practice law firm, not an excluded type. Independently confirmed: HTTPS, practice-area pages, two offices, attorney profiles, reviews carousel; meta description misspells the firm as 'Lonsky'; only a WebSite JSON-LD block, no LocalBusiness; tel: hrefs contain spaces and parentheses; no copyright line in the footer; a single 4-field Dimeform contact form and no scheduler; Google Maps card shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', zero reviews and no photos (strongest single gap). Corrected scores: gap 5 to 4 (the site has HTTPS, a working form, real service pages and a reviews section, so it is weak rather than empty); evidence 4 to 3 (a cited URL 404s and one operational claim is unsupported). Pay 3 and ease 4 stand.

results.name: Lawyer: H. Scott Aalsberg, Esq., P.C.
results.notes: Operating, not an excluded type. Both domains checked directly. aalsberg.com: no viewport meta, fixed-width layout (document renders 1134px wide), no H1, zero tel: links, zero forms, zero JSON-LD, footer reads 'Copyright 2021' - every listed defect holds. getnotguilty.com: proper viewport meta, H1 present, 9 tel: links, 2 forms, a LocalBusiness JSON-LD block with phone/price range, no booking calendar. Google Maps: 4.9 from 273 reviews, 'Open 24 hours', G-10 Brier Hill Ct address, website field points to getnotguilty.com, and a review excerpt about price matches the record. robots.txt: aalsberg.com is a bare Sitemap line; getnotguilty.com is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' (nothing blocked). Scores stand: gap 3 is at the low end given the broken legacy domain and no booking anywhere, but the reasoning is sound; pay 4, ease 4 and evidence 5 all fit what I saw.

results.name: Schorpp Capital Management

wrong_claims.claim: No click-to-call link on the mobile home page despite a phone-centric practice
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The home page carries three tel: links; tel:732-387-2054 is valid and clickable in the footer contact block. The real defect is different: two of the tel: links are attached to the 'Email:' labels (their href points at tel:(984) 208-8887, a malformed number), and the working call link sits about 7,900px down the page, well past the fold.

results.notes: Operating RIA-style practice; not an excluded type. Confirmed: FinancialService JSON-LD with 1200 Tices Ln, East Brunswick NJ 08816; embedded Levitate 15-minute meeting scheduler iframe on /contact; labelled contact form (name, email, message, SMS consent); footer '© 2023'; the home page scrolls 909px wide at a 390px viewport and a phone-width screenshot shows the hero headline cut off at the right edge with the blue logo graphic overlapping it - the mobile finding is accurate. Home page has one 'Get in touch' link to /contact at ~2,160px down, so 'no form or booking CTA above the fold' holds. Only the click-to-call issue is wrong, so evidence drops 4 to 3; gap 3, pay 4 and ease 5 are reasonable.

results.name: Aim Realty

wrong_claims.claim: No inquiry form and no call to action; contact_form false; conversion depends entirely on the visitor emailing or dialling
wrong_claims.what_is_true: https://homes30.com/contact/ carries a working Contact Form 7 form with required Name, Email, Subject and Message fields plus a submit button, and it rendered normally for me (no hang). What is true is that the home page has no tel: link, no form and no CTA button, and the nav phone number is plain text.

results.notes: Operating single-agent brokerage (Steven Schrager, Aim Realty Corp), not an excluded type. Confirmed: footer reads '© AIM Realty Corp. 2018'; zero tel: links and phone numbers as plain text; home page forms are site-search only; 'Home Search' buttons point at cjmls.rapmls.com MLS-login URLs and a flexmls link, with the page's own 'CONTACT US' label wired to a CJMLS login URL; a Covid-19 page is still in the menu (/covid-19/); robots.txt is empty; JSON-LD is a Yoast WebPage/Organization graph with no LocalBusiness. Google Maps shows Aim Realty at 49 W Prospect St with 5.0 and no count displayed, so the aggregator-based listing record is thin but not contradicted. Corrected: gap 5 to 4 and evidence 4 to 3 because the 'no inquiry form' claim is false; pay 2 and ease 5 stand.

results.name: McSweeney Engineering
results.notes: Operating sole-practitioner MEP engineering practice; not an excluded type. HTTPS on port 443 is refused (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED); the page is only reachable over http and the HTML confirms HTML 4.01 Transitional, 'Intuit SiteBuilder by Homestead', a fixed 810px centred container, no viewport meta, no form, no tel: link, phone 908-227-9302 and michael@mcsweeney-eng.com as plain text, the 'beleive' typo, a Homestead footer badge and no copyright line. PE licensure in NJ/NY/CT/IN and LEED AP text confirmed. robots.txt is the Homestead default: it disallows only internal /~site/Scripts_* paths, so assistant crawling is not blocked. Google Maps shows the listing with 'Claim this business', a 5.0 rating with no count, no photos and a website field pointing at the http domain - unclaimed and effectively unreviewed. Scores stand: gap 5, pay 2, ease 5, evidence 4.

results.name: Axias, Inc.
results.notes: Operating construction cost consultancy; not an excluded type. Confirmed: title 'Axias - Construction Cost Estimating' with no town, empty meta description, zero ld+json blocks, footer '© 2024', a single tel: link to the 703 (Alexandria VA) number, and /contact/ listing HQ in Alexandria with the East Brunswick office (197 Route 18 South, Suite 200, office lead Thomas Joseph) as one of four 'Additional Locations'. The contact form is a Kadence form with 7 visible fields and zero label elements inside it (the record said 8 fields / 2 labels, slightly off but the substance - unlabelled fields - holds); no CAPTCHA seen. Google Maps shows 'Axias, Inc.' at 197 NJ-18 Ste 200, category 'Consultant', no rating, no photos and 'Claim this business' - unclaimed. Scores stand: gap 3, pay 5, ease 4, evidence 4.

results.name: Office Space Planners, Inc.

wrong_claims.claim: No contact or quote form anywhere, so 'Quick Quote' dead-ends; contact_form false; bookable 0 because the contact page has no form of any kind
wrong_claims.what_is_true: /contact/ contains a full Ninja Forms quote-request form: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Company Name, Project Address, Approximate Square Footage, Number of Employees, Project Description and service-type checkboxes, with a Google reCAPTCHA. 'Quick Quote' and 'Get Started' therefore land on a real quote form, not a dead end.

wrong_claims.claim: Internal links point at 404 URLs (/contact-us/, /quick-quote/) before falling back to /contact/
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Both URLs do return HTTP 404, but no link on the home page points at either one - its only internal links are /contact, /contact/ and one PDF - so the 'internal links point at 404s' framing is not supported.

wrong_claims.claim: Copyright is stale / site shows out-of-date signs
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The footer reads 'Copyright © 2026 Office Space Planners', which is current.

results.notes: Operating nationwide space-planning firm (since 1988, GSA work, Portland OR corporate office plus LA and East Orange NJ), not an excluded type. Confirmed: claimed Google Maps profile with category 'Interior designer', 5.0 rating, hours and phone, no 'Claim this business' prompt; click-to-call tel:1-877-918-1947; a phone-width screenshot shows the top-bar '(877) 918-1947' clipped at the right edge and the hero panel sitting off-centre, so the mobile finding holds; no ld+json beyond generic WebPage markup; titles omit the town. Google assigns the East Orange (212) 599-1010 number to the East Brunswick listing, a separate listing problem the record did not note. Corrected scores: the site already has a complete quote form, HTTPS, a claimed 5.0 profile and click-to-call, so gap 3 to 2; evidence 4 to 2 because the central top issue and a supporting claim are wrong.

results.name: BCT Partners

wrong_claims.claim: The contact page's 'Click here' link is missing its href, so there is no inbound RFI path / the link is broken
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The 'Click here' element is a Wix lightbox trigger (aria-label 'Click here', data-popupid set) rather than a dead link: clicking it opens a popup containing an embedded contactcollection.com email-signup field. There is still no message/RFI form and no named recipient on the page, so 'no inbound RFI path' mostly holds, but the mechanism described is wrong.

results.notes: Operating management consultancy; not an excluded type. Confirmed: only a WebSite JSON-LD block; footer '© BCT Partners 2022'; home page has no forms and one tel: link; the header nav runs off the right edge at phone width (measured a 1,248px document inside a 500px window, nav cut mid-word, horizontal scrollbar visible) so the mobile finding holds; Google Maps shows 2.7 stars, 'Claim this business', 'Add a photo' and no photos; about page confirms 175+ employees and contractors, 24 years and Dr. Randal Pinkett as founder/CEO. Evidence 4 to 3 for the wrong mechanism claim; gap 4, pay 5 and ease 3 are reasonable.

data_gaps: Claimed-versus-unclaimed status was read only from the public Google Maps card ('Claim this business' present or absent); ownership cannot be confirmed without signing in, which is out of scope.
Google Maps review counts were not displayed in several limited Map views (Aim Realty 5.0, McSweeney 5.0, Office Space Planners 5.0, Axias no rating), so exact counts could not be re-verified.
Shamy, Shipers & Lonski: the URL cited for hours and for the 'weekends by appointment' signal (/contact) returns HTTP 404, so that operational claim could not be checked.

McSweeney Engineering: the site blocks plain HTTP loads in this browser (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT), so I read the page HTML via a direct HTTP GET and could not take a phone-width screenshot; the mobile conclusion rests on the absent viewport meta and the fixed 810px table layout.
BCT Partners: Chrome would not render narrower than a 500px window with device emulation cleared, so mobile overflow was measured at 500px (1,248px document) rather than exactly 390px.
Aim Realty: the 5.0 / 3-review listing was attributed to a PropertyManagementSearch aggregator page that I did not open; Google Maps independently shows 5.0 with no count displayed.
